cohort: 121 pregnant women hospitalized due to COVID-19 and their 114 newborns between March 2020 and April 2022.
finding: There were no cases of vertical transmission of COVID-19, but there were increased rates of cesarean deliveries, maternal deaths, prematurity, and low birth weight among the infected mothers compared to pre-pandemic rates.
mod_finding: The majority of births were via cesarean section (50.41%).
